label: Active fire detections
source: MODIS MOD14A1/MYD14A1 v061 (Terra+Aqua daily 1 km FireMask) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: count of daily 1 km fire pixels (FireMask 7-9, all confidence levels) inside county, summed over Terra and Aqua and all days of the month
notes: Comparable to FIRMS MODIS counts (FIRMS API not reachable from build env). Strongly seasonal (dry season Nov-Mar). index_ok false because many county-months are 0.

label: Burned area
source: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 burned area via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: sum of burned 500 m pixels (Burn_Date>0) x pixel area (sinusoidal equal-area, 0.2147 km2)
notes: Monthly burned area; zero in most wet-season months.

label: Burned area (% of county)
source: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 burned area via Microsoft Planetary Computer
aggregation: burned pixels / all pixels in county x 100
